items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] I know Baby Dodds, I know when he left him.

ctx.x: A friend of mine who is dead now from Chicago, I knew him out of Chicago, Baby Dodds, you came from here. I know Baby Dodds. And he started with the imperial method too.
I know Baby Dodds, I know when he left him. I was playing Tom Ashton, he was playing on the captain with Fate and Marble.
Oh, that's right, Johnny. He worked on the boat.

items.title: Albert Francis Interview, 1961-08-04
items.q: He was good, yeah. Well, I know him a twine

ctx.x: Walter Brunson. Yeah. Baby Dodd said he used to take lessons from him. He liked him.
He was good, yeah. Well, I know him a twine, there was no read. And one named Mack Murray.
